latHint: Think flipping pages with a finger - not a tree part.
pivHint: Turning over a new LEAF starts the year fresh - but to LEAF through a book is also to what through it?
winText: Page by page. LEAF was the pivot - a page to THUMB through a book.
lossText: THUMB - to flip through pages. LEAF was the pivot: a new LEAF to LEAFing through a book.
